question: Kartik Aaryan won the Best Performance in a Leading Role (Male) award at the 25th IIFA Awards held in March 2025 at Jaipur for his performance in which of the following films?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kartik Aaryan** is a well-known Bollywood actor celebrated for his versatile performances across various genres.
 
• The **25th IIFA Awards** were held in **March 2025** at **Jaipur**, Rajasthan, one of India's prominent cultural and historical cities.
 
• At the awards ceremony, Kartik Aaryan received the **Best Performance in a Leading Role (Male)** award for his role in **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**, a sequel to the highly successful Bhool Bhulaiyaa franchise. *Hence, the correct option is Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3.*
 
• **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3** is a highly anticipated sequel and continues the legacy of the franchise, which combines elements of comedy, horror, and psychological intrigue.
 
• The film highlights Kartik Aaryan’s ability to perform in complex roles that demand both emotional depth and comedic timing.
 
• The recognition at the IIFA Awards adds to Kartik Aaryan’s growing stature as one of Bollywood’s leading actors and reflects his impactful performance in the film.
 
• The IIFA Awards are among the most prestigious awards in the Indian film industry, celebrating cinematic excellence and global outreach.* Hence, this achievement is notable in Kartik's career.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Bhool Bhulaiyaa Franchise:**

 
 
• **Bhool Bhulaiyaa** is a popular Bollywood franchise known for blending **horror, psychological twists, and humor**. The first installment starred Akshay Kumar and was released in **2007**.
 
• The sequel, **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2**, released in **2022**, featured Kartik Aaryan and was a box office success, revitalizing the franchise.
 
• **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**, the latest addition, continues the series' tradition of suspense and entertainment, showcasing Kartik Aaryan’s talent in a complex narrative.
 
 
 
• **About Kartik Aaryan:**
 
 
• **Kartik Aaryan**, born on **22 November 1990**, is an Indian actor who debuted with **Pyaar Ka Punchnama** in **2011**.
 
• He is renowned for his roles in films like **Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety**, **Luka Chuppi**, **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2**, and **Satyaprem Ki Katha**.
 
• His performances have earned him accolades and established him as one of the leading actors in the Indian film industry.
 
 
 
• **About IIFA Awards:**
 
 
• The **International Indian Film Academy (IIFA)** Awards are held annually to recognize excellence in Indian cinema.
 
• These awards are known for their global presence and are hosted in different countries and cities, promoting Indian cinema worldwide.
 
• The **25th edition** held in **Jaipur** showcased the best of Bollywood and celebrated achievements in acting, direction, music, and production.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Nominations:**

 
 
• While Kartik Aaryan won for **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**, other films like **Shehzada** and **Satyaprem Ki Katha** were notable mentions in his career.
 
• These films demonstrate his versatility and ability to perform across genres, from romantic dramas to action comedies.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Award:**
 
 
• The **IIFA Award** for Best Performance in a Leading Role (Male) is a prestigious recognition, highlighting the actor’s impact on Indian cinema.
 
• This award further establishes Kartik Aaryan as a bankable and talented star in the industry.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact:**
 
 
• The **IIFA Awards** promote Indian cinema on a global stage, showcasing the diversity and creativity of Bollywood.
 
• Recognitions like Kartik’s award help Bollywood actors gain international acclaim and recognition.
